summary.text: Darrin Madison Jr. is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 10, where he took office on January 3, 2023, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election against Robert Longwell-Grice of the Green Party.

paragraphs.text: Darrin Madison Jr. graduated from Ronald Reagan High School in 2015 and earned a B.A. in biology from Howard University in 2019.

His career experience includes working as a program coordinator for Youth Justice Milwaukee and as an eco-neighborhoods outreach specialist for the City of Milwaukee's environmental collaboration office.
He also volunteered as a coordinator for the Urban Ecology Center.
Madison assumed office in the Assembly in January 2023.
For 2025-2026 his committee assignments were Corrections; Science, Technology, and AI; Urban Revitalization; and Information Policy and Technology.
